summary: Filtering findings by category, subcategory and department is now quicker.

new.title: Dropdown filters for category and department
new.text: Category, Subcategory and Department are now dropdown filters on the Summary and Detailed findings. You tick one or more values and see the number of findings for each.

fixes.title: Easier-to-read filter menus
fixes.text: In every filter's value menu, each value now sits next to its tick box.
